x-idempotency.replayBehavior: resolve the current versioned entitlement snapshot without creating a durable domain mutation

x-p1r-idempotency-exception.reason: This internal POST carries a closed read precondition body and resolves a versioned entitlement fact; it does not mutate the entitlement ledger.
x-p1r-idempotency-exception.safeBehavior: Every call is workload-authorized and fail-closed against the current policy and invalidation versions; no payment, order, refund, or entitlement mutation is permitted.

M1015IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
M1015IdempotencyKey.description: 同一路由、主体和 tenant 的同 key 同摘要重放原回执；同 key 不同请求摘要必须返回 409。

M1015Provider.name: provider
M1015Provider.description: Phase 1 只允许 sandbox HMAC；生产 provider、凭据和真实流量不可达。

M1015ProviderSignature.name: X-Provider-Signature
M1015ProviderSignature.description: 仅供受控 provider ingress 短暂验签，禁止持久化、事件传播或日志记录。

M1015ProviderNonce.name: X-Provider-Nonce
M1015ProviderNonce.description: provider callback 的短时防重放 nonce；只在验签/去重边界使用。

M1015ProviderKeyId.name: X-Provider-Key-Id
M1015ProviderKeyId.description: HMAC shared-secret 的不透明服务端 key reference；仅 ACTIVE 单一 key 可用于验签，unknown/revoked/expired key 一律拒绝，key material 不进入契约、日志或事件。

M1017TelemetryIdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
M1017TelemetryIdempotencyKey.description: 同一认证主体和同一客户端事件摘要重放原回执；同 key 不同摘要必须拒绝。

B13RateLimited.description: Telemetry ingress 被限流；不得阻塞领域事实写入

sourceRef.description: 仅 opaque payment/refund/redemption reference，不得是 code、digest、hash 或 PII。

M1015Entitlement.x-grace-policy: GRACE defaults to zero; only the most recently verified ACTIVE fact may use bounded grace. Refund, revoke, expire, security and unknown always deny.

activationCode.description: 仅通过 TLS 短暂传输；只在服务端内存中用于 SHA-256 digest，一次兑换后不得再次使用。

M1015ReconciliationRecoveryReceipt.description: Replay/recovery request receipt only. It is not the post-rerun closure event; commerce.reconciliation.recovery_receipted.v2 separately records CLOSED with MATCHED_AFTER_RECOVERY.

B13Problem.description: Compatibility error payload for existing commerce, admin and analytics operations. New or migrated operations use ApiError inside ApiErrorEnvelope.

code.description: 仅通过 TLS 短暂传输，服务端只保存 hash，日志和事件禁止记录原文。

token.description: 一次性短时确认令牌；仅允许通过 TLS 进入内存请求头，不得写入日志、数据库、URL 或客户端持久化。

M1016SupportRestrictedContentRef.x-client-authority: NONE; content is a server-issued redacted reference

M1016SupportAttachmentRef.x-client-authority: NONE; media authorization and scan status are server-derived

M1016SupportUsableContentRef.x-input-policy: Only CLEAN redacted content references may enter a ticket or message command

M1016SupportUsableAttachmentRef.x-input-policy: Only CLEAN scanned attachments may enter a ticket or message command

M1016SupportAssignment.x-state-invariant: OPEN may have null assigneeRef/assignedAt; ASSIGNED, WAITING_INTERNAL, RESOLVED, CLOSED and REOPENED require both values after assignment

M1016SupportRetention.x-client-authority: NONE; retention and legal hold are server-derived

M1016SupportTicket.x-client-authority: NONE for tenant, requester, priority, assignment, SLA, state, resolution and audit facts
M1016SupportTicket.x-state-invariant: RESOLVED or CLOSED requires resolution; OPEN, ASSIGNED, WAITING_USER, WAITING_INTERNAL and REOPENED must not expose a resolution fact

M1016SupportTicketCreateRequest.x-client-authority: Only category/resource/redacted content references/attachment references/idempotencyKey are client-writable

M1016SupportMessage.x-client-authority: NONE for author, tenant and support state

M1016SupportMessageCreateRequest.x-client-authority: Only message reference/content, attachment references, expectedVersion and idempotencyKey are client-writable

M1016SupportAssignCommand.x-client-authority: Only command input and CAS version are client-writable; assignment is PEP-checked and server-applied
